description: Paid: 0.01 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Agent access-policy change readings across all tracked domains since a time (default 7 days), raw readings first: domain, file path, time, old and new SHA-256 and HTTP status, and for robots.txt a summary of user-agent groups added or removed and rule counts changed. File text is not redistributed. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 time, e.g. 2026-10-13T00:00:00Z (default: 7 days ago)

name: get_access_policy_changes
title: Agent access-policy change feed (all tracked domains) (paid: 0.01 RLUSD / 0.01 USDC on Base / 0.01 RLUSD on Base via x402)
